title: Xiaomi 17 Ultra is slowly convincing me to leave my big camera at home| Technology News
text:
Leica colour science at play
To put it plainly, Xiaomi seems to have mastered the colours here. You have two Leica colour modes to choose from, Leica Authentic and Leica Vibrant. Leica Authentic colour science is closer to what you would get with Leica cameras, while Leica Vibrant is more in line with how other flagship phones tend to perform. It is brighter and more social media ready. Personally, I believe people with a more artistic inclination will prefer the Leica Authentic look. I certainly do.
